'''Differential algebraic geometry''' is an area of [[differential algebra]] that adapts concepts and methods from [[algebraic geometry]] and applies them to systems of [[differential equation]]s, especially [[algebraic differential equation]]s.

Another way of generalizing ideas from algebraic geometry is [[diffiety|diffiety theory]].
